description: Defines the ParameterListImpl class, a container for managing a list of torch::Tensor parameters within the torch::nn namespace, including methods for appending, extending, iterating, and accessing parameters.

classes.name: ParameterListImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a parameter list container for torch::Tensor objects, supporting iteration, access, and modification.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a tensor parameter to the end of the list, with overloads for rvalue and lvalue references, and for OrderedDict items.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the parameter list with elements from a container.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the start of the parameter list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the parameter list.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses a parameter by index, throws if index is out of range.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a parameter by index, same as at().

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters in the list.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the parameter list is empty.
